scientific_status.purpose: prospective confirmation of development-discovered taxon-specific spatial response modes

future_data_boundary.response: first NEON small-mammal observations not contained in RELEASE-2026
future_data_boundary.sampling_rules: copy exact-3-night standard-grid, completeness, target taxonomy, m>=5, saturation<=0.30, metric and genus-MNKA definitions unless NEON protocol itself changes before response access
future_data_boundary.protocol_change_rule: if future NEON protocol is incompatible, stop and write a new structural estimability contract before opening future W/B effects

future_effect_blind_support_gate.per_taxon_minimum_for_confirmatory_slope: at least 3 eligible response sessions with at least 2 distinct genus-MNKA values
future_effect_blind_support_gate.geographic_requirement: report sites before effects; no taxon is replaced by another if sparse
future_effect_blind_support_gate.sparse_taxon_rule: taxon remains preregistered but is marked not estimable; do not substitute a development-favorable taxon

primary_confirmatory_estimand.definition: equal-taxon-weighted signed Delta, where positive-mode taxa use +Delta and negative-mode taxa use -Delta
primary_confirmatory_estimand.weighting: each estimable frozen taxon concept has equal total weight
primary_confirmatory_estimand.nuisance_adjustment: same taxon x plot series, site x month and year fixed-effect structure where identifiable in future data

directional_replication_guard.rule: at least 6 of the 7 frozen taxon-specific Delta estimates must have the preregistered sign, provided all 7 are estimable
directional_replication_guard.partial_estimability_rule: if fewer than 7 are estimable, require all but at most one estimable taxon to match and do not claim seven-taxon confirmation

secondary_future_predictions.positive_mode_taxa: Delta > 0; strong-form W<0 and B>=0 is secondary, not required for sign-mode confirmation
secondary_future_predictions.negative_mode_taxa: Delta < 0; B<0 is a prespecified mechanistic secondary prediction because development negative mode was driven by centre compression

forbidden_rescues: replace a failed frozen taxon with another taxon
flip or merge sign classes after future results
select habitat, territoriality, body size or sociality moderators based on future sign failures
combine RELEASE-2026 development rows into the confirmatory estimate
external_dataset_relation: Borneo or another independent CMR dataset may provide a separate external test, but does not consume or modify this future-NEON confirmation contract
